title.narrative: Basic health care & prevention of& response to COVID19 in refugee camps in Kigoma

description.narrative: UNHCR’s health priorities for the 3 refugee camps in Kigoma region for 2021 include:• Improving and strengthening the quality of reproductive health services including family planning and adolescent health to reduce maternal mortality.• Improving the quality of health services and maintaining low crude and under five mortality rates; • Increasing access and quality of health services through renovation, expansion and equipping of health facilities;• Maintain drugs and medical supplies in the health facilities serving Burundian and Congolese populations respectively. COVID-19• In close coordination with District Medical Officers, UNHCR will support capacity building of health workers in government hospitals in refugee hosting districts, partners, UNHCR staff and community leaders in the camps. • Where need arises, UNHCR will also support risk communication activities on COVID-19 and beef up the capacity of designated isolation facilities in refugee hosting districts. • Provide the means to allow for the safe reception of asylum seekers in the case of an influx.The following are the core areas of UNHCR’s health programme in the three refugee camps in Western Tanzania:1. Provision of Preventive and community health care services (COVID- 19 response)2. Access to primary health care services;3. Establishment of Medical Referral mechanism;4. Provision of Care and treatment for PoCs living with HIV and AIDS;5. Provision of Comprehensive safe motherhood services provided.Maintain the Crude Mortality Rate (CMR) and Under Five Mortality Rate (U5MR) in the camps below Sphere minimal standards of <0.75/1,000 population/month for Crude Mortality Rate (CMR) and <1.5/1,000 population/month for under-five mortality rate (U5MR).
